resources.string:
LabelLens gives you information about ingredients, gathered from public scientific and regulatory sources.

It is not medical advice, and it is not a diagnosis. Ratings are general guidance and cannot account for your full medical history.

Always read the physical packaging for allergen information, and talk to a doctor, dietitian or pharmacist about your own health.
LabelLens needs your camera to scan barcodes and read ingredient labels. Images are processed on your device and are never uploaded.
Product data from Open Food Facts, used under the Open Database License. Ingredient safety information from EFSA, FDA and other public sources.
